verdict.rationale: The only evidence near bulk operations is indirect. Account Admins can manage user access across all linked workspaces, unified multi-framework action items cut repeated work, and a unified task view lets users manage and assign tasks across frameworks and workspaces. The documented MCP actions (adding comments, attachments and status updates to evidence requests) appear to work one item at a time. Missing for 10: explicit bulk select/edit/assign operations, bulk actions through MCP or API, documentation of limits or behavior for batch changes, and independent corroboration.
